notes.title: v0.18 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Water Tank and Plastic Canister[/h2]
Some POIs now feature a water tank. The tank contains between 20 and 90 units of clean water, which can be drunk directly or transferred to various water containers. The water respawns every 90 minutes. This addition is particularly interesting if you're starting a fresh game, as it reduces the hassle of making your own clean water early game.

Players can now find a plastic canister. It can hold 600 units of water and is therefore useful for transporting larger amounts of water.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/12cfab618bd1f14e0f7b14ba1275c3d6d92497f9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/b830208979a10c4439b48d859393494feb062d0b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Fence Reinforcement[/h2]
Players can now reinforce the wooden fence with an iron ingot for 120 additional hit points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/bfbfe82cc1eeb16acc313817769d30101f5cbee7.jpg[/img]

[h2]Other Notable Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] added explanation pop-ups for the sleeping bag, totem and horde crystals 
[*] added sfx for recharging the flashlight with a battery
[*] increased spear throw force slightly
[*] plastic bottle now shows fill percentage when laying on the ground
[*] remaining ammo is shown for firearms hanging on the toolrack
[*] added tutorial task to place the campfire rack
[*] increased water barrel capacity from 1500 to 1800
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] door was stuck in old position when doorway was moved
[*] same screen resolution was shown multiple times in options menu
[*] max flashlight capacity was not applied correctly when game was reloaded
[/list]

Have a great day!

notes.title: v0.16 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Revised Planting System and Healing Herbs[/h2]
All crops now use the same type of seeds. Players have a 40% chance of receiving a seed when harvesting plants growing in the forest. When harvesting a crop from the plant bed, players get the original seed back.

You can now grow [b]healing herbs[/b] in plant beds. Harvesting the plant will heal the player to maximum health. There is a 3 minute cooldown between consuming healing herbs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/1a5c09e93cd8288bf22c36a404528fce22b295c5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Spikes Upgrade[/h2]
Players can now upgrade spikes using one iron ingot. Upgraded spikes are dealing [b]50% more damage[/b].

Due to a change in the structure upgrading system, existing reinforcements on foundations and walls are lost, but can easily be rebuilt!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/4bcc863ecf2e2a7e100712edfaf617794241206b.gif[/img]

[h3]Other Notable Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] daytime brightness was slightly increased
[*] max flashlight charge increased to 1 hour
[*] flashlight charge perk now increases max charge by 20 minutes per level
[*] added hint how to place sleeping bag
[*] added flashlight empty notification
[*] added wind sway effect to corn and cucumber plants
[*] starting loot is now found next to a tree
[/list]

Have a great day!

notes.title: v0.15 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Horde System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/61f8bd7aa057bb3784428a344854d1333da41f32.gif[/img]
The horde system has been reworked. Players now can place the totem to call horde waves. After defeating the horde players receive a perk point which can be used to unlock passive perks (e.g. more inventory slots). With each horde level the difficulty increases - players can remain at a specific horde level until they feel comfortable progressing. Night hordes are significantly weaker and adjust their strength to the current wave level on the totem. The amount of waves will be increased in the future, for now the totem supports 25 waves.

[h2]Perks[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/c875e96f9e863d55e657a46a48d8c0c7f7b4082a.jpg[/img]
[b]Survival Perks[/b]
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]MAX HEALTH[/td]
        [td]max health increased by 15 per level[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]FLASHLIGHT CAPACITY[/td]
        [td]flashlight capacity increased by 200s per level[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]INVENTORY SLOTS[/td]
        [td]unlocks one additional inventory slot per level[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]STAMINA REGENERATION[/td]
        [td]stamina regeneration increased by 10% per level[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]REPAIR HAMMER EFFICIENCY[/td]
        [td]repair hammer efficiency increased by 25% per level[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
[b]Combat Perks[/b]
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]MELEE DAMAGE[/td]
        [td]melee damage increased by 10% per level[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]FIREARM DAMAGE[/td]
        [td]firearm damage increased by 10% per level[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
[b]Technology Perks[/b]
[table]
    [tr]
        [td]TURRET DAMAGE[/td]
        [td]defense turret damage increased by 15% per level[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]COPPER EXTRACTION[/td]
        [td]allows mineral extractors to harvest copper ore[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Players can now receive an immediate reward after defeating the night horde.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/c26c4e85c47e5e53d4ec33fce09c61f14294ac4a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Inventory Expansion[/h2]
Players can unlock up to 4 additional inventory slots in the perk menu. The first 4 slots are now accessible with hotkeys 1 to 4. Items can now be moved in the inventory by drag and drop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/45bf97790222a6efd582881edd3050605a369099.jpg[/img]

[h2]Mineral Extractor[/h2]
Players can place the mineral extractor at certain drill site locations to automatically harvest ores. When powered with 5 power units, the mineral extractor can harvest two types of ores:
[list]
[*] [b]iron ore[/b] (5 minutes per extraction)
[*] [b]copper ore[/b] (8 minutes per extaction)
[/list]
The mineral extractor can store up to 8 ores, after which it must be emptied to continue harvesting.

In order to [b]harvest copper[/b], the corresponding perk must be unlocked. Currently, copper can be used to craft electrical components, but will be necessary for structure upgrades in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/abf5b42fe3b7457e5915e4248da3ffd9826d8ade.jpg[/img]

[h3]Other Notable Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] reworked survival guide UI
[*] furnace now shows the smelting progress
[/list]

Have a great day!

notes.title: v0.14 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Advanced Electricity[/h2]
Players can now create more complex electric networks. When placing an electric structure it automatically connects to all electric nodes within range. If the total power consumption in a grid exceeds the total generation, the flow of electricity is interrupted. Players can restore the flow by switching off individual consumers or increasing the power generation.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th][/th]
        [th]energy generation[/th]
        [th][/th]
        [th]energy usage[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]generator[/td]
        [td]10[/td]
        [td]defense turret[/td]
        [td]3[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]solar panel[/td]
        [td]up to 6[/td]
        [td]interior & exterior light[/td]
        [td]1[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
[h3]Solar Panel[/h3]
The [b]solar panel[/b] is a new type of passive power generation. After construction, the solar panel must be mounted with two panels before it can start generating power. The efficiency of the solar panel varies with the time of day and reaches its maximum at midday. Solar panels can be found at outpost locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/a1d1ee68f3871f61f617dc9945a2cee7d448de1d.jpg[/img]
[h3]Battery Rack[/h3]
Players can store energy using a [b]battery rack[/b]. Similar to the solar panel, the battery rack must first be mounted with car batteries before it can store energy. The energy capacity increases by 1000 per added car battery. Car batteries can be found at the new hut POI. Connected battery racks automatically charge and discharge according to the power grid requirements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/34e356e645a150d348981fee362b4fdfc2656a70.jpg[/img]
[h3]Fuse Box[/h3]
Using the [b]fuse box[/b], players can get an insight into the current grid power generation, load and total stored energy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/2e9d0ab2d4448fd143052852c74cf90afc9e5b06.jpg[/img]
[h3]Power Relay[/h3]
Players can use [b]power relays[/b] to transmit electricity over greater distances.

[h3]Exterior Light[/h3]
[b]Exterior lights[/b] were added to illuminate the outside of your base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/95ff48ffd8d884f0cb9bd96324471678b5431b14.jpg[/img]

[h2]New POI: Hut[/h2]
The hut is located next to the lake in the northeast of the map. Here players can collect car batteries for energy storage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/a3f0d77be01846275926530eaff5bd6eca3f1c91.jpg[/img]

[h3]Other Notable Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] updated the tutorial images displayed when starting a new game
[/list]

Have a great day!

notes.title: v0.13 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Wooden Housing Expansion[/h2]
The appearance of all housing structures was reworked. Also new structures were added to further customize your base:
[list]
[*] interior light
[*] interior wall
[*] half wall
[*] railing
[*] window
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/5a8301ba3af9fc9b4178ce9fa81f3eac27fb5df1.jpg[/img]
The structure upgrade system was reworked. Structures can now be upgraded directly by attaching metal sheets. They can be reinforced in several places, each reinforcement cost one iron ingot. When a structure is attacked, the reinforcements are first damaged before the actual structure is damaged.

[b]NOTE: Due to the change in snap points, your housing structures may be offset. You can put them back in the right place by right-clicking and selecting "Move". Old versions of reinforced structures are removed.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/37a8a6f23c7c57aa646b25ecfaeafe7b83541f44.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Melee Weapon: Machete[/h2]
A new high-damage dealing melee weapon was added: The machete. It can be found at the radio tower location.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/78a17b6535ef962421121674a746d918fa11f5c6.jpg[/img]

[h3]Other Notable Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] added stationary light sources to POIs, since collecting the portable work light would permanently darken the place
[*] added SFX for picking up and placing items
[*] added SFX for adding fuel to fire places
[*] reworked log wall, log wall with door and spikes textures
[*] added hint to open the map
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] new work lights were spawned each time the game loaded
[*] flashlight did not work when playing on lowest quality settings
[/list]

notes.title: v0.12 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Ambient Changes[/h2]
The forest atomsphere has been adjusted to match the mystical setting of OddWoods. The forest will be darker at nighttime and having enough light at you base will be important when fighting the hordes. Work lights found around the map can be collected to illuminate your base. More light variations will be available in future updates. The large lake on the map was replaced by multiple smaller lakes.

Collectable stones, sticks and plants in the forest are highlighted as you approach them, as they are difficult to see in the dark.

The number of working lights found on the map was increased. You can continue playing on old saves, although a fresh start is required to collect the added working lights. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/6776476594f045182fbb186a80affe1675acffce.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/05819626d88f7d6e803c975b2a0872247d6fc689.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Creature: Spider Bug[/h2]
The cave was removed, iron and clay can now be collected at the mineral site. The minerals are guarded by a new creature: The spider bug.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/432d054c58e12ef682923cba029b67f3fb278cb8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] changed tree marker color to white
[*] interactions are now highlighted
[*] added hint to indicate flashlight usage
[*] changed crystal appearance
[/list]

P.S.: I have noted the limited inventory space and will work on backpack expansions for future updates.

Have a great holiday everyone!

notes.content:
[h2]Crystals[/h2]
Two crystals appear on the map every morning. Players can locate them by markers and then destroy them with a metal pickaxe. Destroying both crystals before nightfall will weaken the incoming enemy horde. Enemies are only weakened in strength, but not in number.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/b32489943cad5f13ebde5b805e2746f6c85cfcf7.jpg[/img]

[h2]Military Crates[/h2]
Players can find military crates that can contain ammo and pipe bombs at points of interest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/6df1d0525eed604740322389c6f64d95482c1d43.jpg[/img]

[*] reworked main menu

[/list]

[/list]

Have a great day!

notes.title: v0.10 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Explosive Trap[/h2]
Like other structures, explosive traps can be placed via the building menu. Once construction is complete, players must fill the traps with two liters of gasoline. The traps are detonated by firearm projectiles or other close-range explosions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/1a6d9e883dbc8cb21cdfbaea36b4f933d427a121.gif[/img]

[h2]Pipe Bomb[/h2]
Players can find the pipe bombs on the map. After throwing, the bomb will explode after 3 seconds. Structures build by the player are not damaged by explosions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/157f68dd097ed4158f7d8a14fffc052e0121a04d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] removed tertiary interaction key, deleting construction blueprints is now possible by holding right click
[*] drinking water and filling containers from lakes is now done by holding right click
[*] when placing a structure, the equipped item is no longer used when left-clicking
[*] added rock hit effect
[/list]

Have a great day!

tags.feature: added rock hit effect

notes.title: v0.9 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Expanded Difficulty Settings[/h2]
Players can now choose between easy, normal, hard and custom difficulty mode. In the custom difficulty mode are the following settings:
[list]
[*] overall enemy strength
[*] night horde enemy count
[*] night horde limit
[*] nutrition & water depletion rate
[/list]
In easy, normal and hard mode, the night hordes are limited to day 25, after which the enemy count does not increase any further. Players can change or disable this limit in the custom settings.

[h2]Lookout Tower & Campsite[/h2]
This update features two new points of interest with loot. Also tools and weapons are now respawning.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/17556e4934f088c4d4feeeffe37f9acd8b276dc4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/409e76be56039123dbabea413a3a671cf545cc64.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Creature: Necromutant[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/a5cba946eec9e8cac699ee26cff156fdd3d40eed.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Items[/h2]
[list]
[*] rope
[*] energy drink (40 hydration, refills 100 stamina)
[*] crackers (40 carbs)
[*] protein bar (30 proteins, 5 carbs)
[*] corn seeds
[*] cucumber seeds
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/b40343cb23f178b9701b12fb056018726fd23752.png[/img]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] added tooltips for the construction menu
[*] reworked vitals UI
[*] generator range can be displayed by right-clicking and selecting "show range"
[*] the cooking pot stand additionally requires one rope to build
[*] dead creatures will despawn automatically
[*] vegetables can no longer be planted with the fruit, but now require the correct seed
[*] crop yield increased from 3 to 4
[*] rebalanced the nutritional values of food items
[/list]

Have a great day

notes.title: v0.8 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

[b]NOTE: A FRESH NEW GAME will be required - no old saves.[/b]

[h2]Map Rework[/h2]
This update interduces a map rework, featuring a 50% larger map with more variation in terrain and vegetation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/a636588ef94fc4e1970daa0cb53241f00d51cdb9.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Motorcycle[/h2]
The motorcycle will be spawned in a damaged state at a campsite. Players will need to find and repair the vehicle in order to use it.
[list]
[*] [b]Repair cost:[/b] 4 vehicle parts
[/list]
Once repaired the motorcycle will be marked on the map. If the motorcycle gets stuck, players can reset it to its original location by clicking "Reset motorcycle" from the pause menu.
The motorcycle needs fuel to run and can be refilled using a jerry can. Players can also store a jerry can on the back of the motorcycle.
In the event of a collision, the motorcycle will be damaged and may stop working. Players can repair it with vehicle parts. One vehicle part repairs the motorcycle for 50%.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/0377e9a67702bf95a66d7e5be685929e1fce5862.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43084538/e4c3cb457ce77bcd7a904665cf856705a7fe6cf7.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Items[/h2]
[list]

notes.title: v0.7 Major Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This update interduces two bunkers, which are accessible at campsites. Players can find loot and a generator in the bunker. The [b]generator[/b] is used to power [b]auto turrets[/b] and will be necessary for more electrical structures in the future. The auto turret must be within range of the generator to be powered. Fuel for the generator is found in gasoline barrels and can then transported to the generator using a [b]jerry can[/b].

Also added a tutorial with some tasks to get started easily.

notes.title: v0.5f1 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This update introduces three difficulty modes:
[list]
[*] [b]EASY[/b] enemies, bosses and hostile animals are 50% weaker; nutrition and water depletes slower
[*] [b]NORMAL[/b] default experience
[*] [b]HARD[/b] enemies, bosses and hostile animals are 50% stronger
[/list]
If you load an old save game, you play in normal mode by default, the difficulty can only be changed by starting a new game. Also added a modern axe, revolver and shotgun that can be found in campsites. Ammo for these firearms will drop from ammo crates at campsites.

notes.title: v0.2f2 Hotfix
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Some were experiencing long save/load times due to garbage collection in the save file after each death. The next time you load the game as usual, the garbage will be removed automatically. However, if you are still experiencing a very long loading time, consider starting a new game. In addition, trees and bushes now respawn every two hours. Due to a change in the save system, all trees, bushes and rocks will be back when you load the save.

[b]CHANGE[/b] - reduced wood foundation building cost from 4 logs and 5 planks to 2 logs and 5 planks
[b]CHANGE[/b] - increased iron spear damage from 18 to 21
[b]CHANGE[/b] - flashlight is now brighter
[b]CHANGE[/b] - trees and bushes now respawn every 2 hours, if not obstructed by structures
[b]CHANGE[/b] - adjusted footstep sounds

[b]FIX[/b] - fixed saving/loading time issue
[b]FIX[/b] - enemies were playing wood hit sound when hitting the player
[b]FIX[/b] - interaction keys can now be remapped in the settings
[b]FIX[/b] - deer slid across the ground when the player approached it while it was grazing
[b]FIX[/b] - plant beds can now only be harvested if there is enough inventory space

Kind regards
